original_failures.name: CLI parser missing ask argument
original_failures.root_cause: The test inherited the workstation LOCALAPPDATA token, so run(['ask']) reached the offline Brain compatibility check before validating the missing argument.
original_failures.change: Isolate LOCALAPPDATA and OMNI_LOCAL_API_TOKEN for this test.

original_failures.name: Rust execution broker process tests
original_failures.root_cause: Child-process tests held the shared lock but did not set their required echo mode, so process-global test environment state leaked across test order.
original_failures.change: Set OMNI_BROKER_TEST_MODE=echo in the two affected tests while holding the existing lock.

original_failures.name: Rust concurrent approval assertion
original_failures.before: Intermittent failure when loser returned ApprovalConsumed instead of the single hard-coded PlanRejectedSingleUse.
original_failures.root_cause: The concurrent loser can fail closed at either the approval compare-and-consume or the plan-ledger single-use boundary, depending on race order.
original_failures.change: Accept either documented fail-closed error code while retaining exactly-one-success assertions.

original_failures.name: Desktop controlled-file verifier
original_failures.before: Exit 1; controlled Rust files reported as changed.
original_failures.root_cause: The verifier hashed CRLF working-tree bytes directly; two committed snapshot entries were also stale relative to the authoritative Git blobs.
original_failures.change: Hash canonical LF UTF-8 text and update the manifest to independently verified authoritative Git-blob hashes.

original_failures.name: Windows CLI smoke
original_failures.root_cause: Two npm scripts used POSIX-only output redirection under Windows cmd.exe.
original_failures.change: Remove output-only /dev/null redirection from the root and package smoke scripts; preserve POSIX shell scripts.
